items.question: How do I book an appointment?
items.answer: You can fill out the booking form on this website, call our front desk directly, or visit us in person to book a slot.

items.question: What insurance plans do you accept?
items.answer: We accept major national health insurance policies. Please check with our billing desk during registration to verify your policy.

items.question: What are your OPD hours?
items.answer: Our general outpatient departments are open Monday to Saturday from 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM. Emergency support is active 24/7.

items.question: Do you provide home sample collection?
items.answer: Yes, we offer home collection services for blood and pathology tests within a 5km radius of the clinic. Book via phone.

content.heading: About Our Health Center
content.body: Founded in 2018, our clinic has committed to making high-quality, empathetic healthcare accessible. We feature clean clinical chambers, a modern dental setup, and fully digital diagnostic labs. With a panel of 15+ consultant doctors and friendly nursing staff, we focus on preventive care and patient satisfaction to deliver wellness outcomes for the entire community.

content.subheading: Send us your query and our clinical desk will get back to you shortly.
